about: Where things live in A1 (docs/layout.md explains each folder). Every program's page sits at the top (the repo root, or V1's top for Veda's programs) and everything else in a folder that says what it is for. tests/layout.test.js fails when a tracked file or folder sits anywhere these lists do not allow. A new program: its page in `pages`, its files in a folder listed in `folders`, and docs/layout.md, in the same change.

files.404.html: GitHub Pages' not-found page: forwards every moved page's old address.
files.firebase-messaging-sw.js: Push service worker. Its scope must cover index.html, so it sits beside it.
files.CLAUDE.md: Claude Code reads it from the repo root.
files.README.md: GitHub shows it on the repo's front page.
files.package.json: npm (test tooling) runs from the root.
files.scrollbar.js: TEMPORARY copy of Shared/scrollbar.js for ORCA, which still loads it from the old root address. Must stay identical (tests/layout.test.js); delete once ORCA loads Shared/scrollbar.js.
files.popups.js: TEMPORARY copy of Shared/popups.js for ORCA, which still loads it from the old root address. Must stay identical (tests/layout.test.js); delete once ORCA loads Shared/popups.js.
files.dragsort.js: TEMPORARY copy of Shared/dragsort.js for ORCA, which still loads it from the old root address. Must stay identical (tests/layout.test.js); delete once ORCA loads Shared/dragsort.js.

folders.Backup: A1Backup: backup.js, backup-merge.js and the repo copies (Index Backups/); its pages are backup-restore.html and backup-export.html at the root
folders.docs: every doc, plan and README, one subfolder per project
folders.Guardian: the one lock (guardian.js); hosts load it from this path
folders.LifeHub: the app switcher (lifehub.js); hosts load it from this path
folders.magi: MAGI's engine, a Python package run as `python -m magi` (its page is magi.html at the root)
folders.Notebook: the journals and the DOCX editor
folders.PriceWatch: the Price Watch extension (Brave loads it unpacked from this folder)
folders.Rules: machine-read rules: cleanup-rules.json, firestore.rules, this file
folders.Shared: files every program loads: scrollbar, popups, controls, dragsort, resizegrip, hoverfx, apphead, profilepick, tabsync, sweep, tni, catdebrief
folders.Shield: the Shield desktop agent (desktop/); its page is shield.html at the root
folders.Shruti: everything of Shruti but its page (shruti.html at the root): app/, books, media, tools, tests, docs, worker
folders.TaskHub: TaskHub's own scripts (its page is index.html at the root)
folders.tests: every A1 test suite (Shruti and the MAGI engine keep theirs in their own folders)
folders.tools: scripts run by hand or by a scheduled task
folders.workers: Cloudflare workers on account 1 (the folder picks the account)

pages.index.html: TaskHub and the journals (the site root serves it)

files.package.json: the V1 build and its tests run from V1/
files.studyos-sw.js: StudyOS's service worker: its scope must cover studyos.html, so it sits beside it
files.manifest.webmanifest: StudyOS's web-app manifest, beside its page

folders.StudyOS: what studyos.html loads: css, js, config, assets, vendor, plus its desktop app
folders.TradeBoard: TradeBoard's desktop app, sync and scripts (its page is tradeboard.html at V1's top)
folders.Launcher: the Launcher extension (Brave loads it unpacked from this folder)
folders.firebase: Firestore rules and config for V1's Firebase project
folders.scripts: the build, tests and Push Changes

files.layout.md: where everything lives (this file's explanation); CLAUDE.md links it
